title: 8 Best Cloud Detection & Response (CDR) Solutions for Every Business Size (2026)
content_md: Quick Answer: CrowdStrike and Wiz (which acquired CDR specialist Gem Security) lead platform CDR; Sysdig leads runtime-grounded detection; Microsoft Defender for Cloud anchors Azure estates; Skyhawk and Permiso are the notable specialists. Duplicate note: our source list carried Skyhawk twice consolidated here, with identity-focused Permiso added as the eighth entry. Cloud attacks finish in minutes: a leaked key becomes cryptomining, data exfiltration, or ransomware before weekly posture scans even run. Cloud Detection & Response (CDR) is the answer to a question posture tools don’t ask what is happening right now? correlating control-plane logs, runtime signals, and identity behavior into attacks-in-progress, then responding. The category is consolidating into CNAPPs (Wiz bought Gem; platforms bolted on detection), while specialists differentiate on identity behavior and automated containment. As organizations audit their environments, understanding Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) mechanisms helps bridge the gap between static posture and live threat detection. Eight options in depth below, sized honestly. How we evaluate: independent editorial analysis; no paid placement; test detections against your own attack simulations. Pricing by model only.
